title: Synthetic conflicting telemetry handling
provenance_detail: Original synthetic evidence-quality guidance created for deterministic diagnostic tests; it is not based on a proprietary data-quality procedure.

chunks.evidence_excerpt: If the same synthetic machine and simulated timestamp contain conflicting readings for one signal, mark the evidence as conflicting. Verify sensor identity, units, timestamp association, and repeat the measurement before selecting a diagnostic explanation.
observable_symptoms: same timestamp has conflicting readings for the same signal
sensor values disagree for one machine
suggested_checks: Verify that both readings name the same machine, signal, unit, and simulated time.
Check the observation and event identifiers for duplication or misassociation.
Repeat the measurement and preserve both original observations.
limitations: Conflict detection identifies an evidence problem only.
It cannot decide which reading is correct or support a root-cause conclusion until the discrepancy is resolved.
